_note: Top-20 Civitai demo set, 2026-10-20. Caption-style per the MOSS enhancer rules; rival's camera talk stripped. 06 (turbo vs final) and 16 (contact sheet) are composites built from these renders.
01_kitchen_dad: A front-camera phone selfie of a white man in his mid-forties, framed chest-up with his right arm extended toward the camera. He has a tired but friendly half-smile, short brown hair going grey at the temples and two days of stubble; the skin shows natural pores and a slight shine on the forehead. He wears a faded navy t-shirt. Behind him is a cluttered home kitchen with dishes stacked by the sink, a kettle and a roll of paper towels on the counter. Flat daylight from a window on the left lights his face evenly, with soft shadows and muted colours. The wide-angle front camera slightly stretches the near shoulder.
02_bilingual_neon: A night photograph of a narrow wet alley in an East Asian city. A vertical neon sign hangs out from the second floor of a dark brick building, glowing against the night. The sign reads, top to bottom, the Chinese characters "营业中" in cyan brushed script and below them the English word "OPEN" in clean white block capitals, both bright and crisp. Rain puddles on the asphalt reflect the sign in smeared magenta and cyan streaks. A closed metal shutter sits below the sign and a single scooter is parked at an angle beside it. Fine drizzle hangs in the air and the far end of the alley fades into darkness.
03_subway_selfie: A vertical front-camera phone selfie on a crowded subway car in the morning. The subject is a man of about thirty-two with three days of stubble, visible pores on his nose, faint dark circles and a small acne scar on his left cheek, wearing a faded green hoodie with white earbuds in. The phone is held at arm's length slightly above eye level. Behind him blurred commuters hold the straps and look at their phones, and the window shows the dark tunnel rushing past. Flat fluorescent ceiling light gives the skin a slightly green cast with no soft shadows. Candid and unposed.
04_noodle_stall: A late-night street-food photograph in Taipei. A small noodle stall glows under two warm tungsten bulbs, with a long horizontal vinyl awning stretched above the counter. The awning is red with large white characters: "老王牛肉面" on the left half and "Old Wang Beef Noodles" on the right half, the Chinese set slightly higher than the English. Steam rises from a tall pot of broth on the counter. A young man in a stained apron stands behind the counter with messy hair and sweat on his brow, ladle in hand. The wet pavement in the foreground reflects the stall lights, and the street behind is dark with a few scooters passing.
05_garden_mug: A front-camera phone selfie of a white woman in her mid-fifties in her back garden in the morning, framed chest-up, holding a coffee mug up near her chin. She has a warm closed-mouth smile, a short grey bob, crow's feet and laugh lines, and no makeup. She wears a green fleece vest over a striped shirt. Tomato plants on canes and a weathered wooden fence fill the background. Cool, soft morning daylight, slightly overcast, with natural skin texture and fine pores visible.
07_chalkboard_menu: A photograph of a tall A-frame chalkboard sign standing on a sunny sidewalk outside an independent cafe. The chalkboard has a thin oak frame and is hand-lettered in white chalk in three columns. The left column is headed "COFFEE" with four lines beneath it: "Flat White 4.50", "Cortado 4.00", "Pour Over 5.00", "Iced Latte 5.50". The middle column is headed "BAKED" with three lines: "Almond Croissant 4.50", "Banana Bread 4.00", "Scone 3.50". The right column is headed "TODAY" with one line: "Cold brew - free refill". A small chalk drawing of a steaming cup sits at the top centre. Morning sun casts the frame's shadow across the pavement, and the cafe's glass door is behind.
08_hill_singer: A cinematic film still from a dramatic low angle, a three-quarter shot from the thighs up of a white American woman in her mid-twenties standing in a windswept wheat field, looking straight into the camera with fierce, defiant eyes and a hint of a smile. Wild copper-red hair blows across her face. She wears a black long-sleeved western dress embroidered with red roses and a white felt cowboy hat, with a plain gold ring on a thin leather cord around her neck. A vintage chrome microphone on a stand is beside her. A dark purple storm sky with a fork of lightning on the horizon, low gold light raking across the wheat from the right.
09_protest_sign: A photograph of a person holding up a cardboard protest sign at an outdoor demonstration in daylight. The sign is a rectangle of brown corrugated cardboard hand-painted in black block capitals on three lines: "RIVERS" on the first line, "ARE NOT" on the second, "FOR SALE" on the third, the lettering uneven and brush-painted with visible bristle marks. The person is cropped to hands and torso in a denim jacket. Behind them, out of focus, other protesters hold signs and a raised megaphone. Slight backlight from an overcast sky.
10_product_label: A product photograph of a single glass jar of orange marmalade standing on a rustic wooden table in front of a plain cream wall, lit by soft window light from the left. The jar has a gingham cloth cap tied with twine. Its paper label is cream with a thin brown border and reads, centred on three lines: "HILLSIDE" in bold brown serif capitals on the first line, "Seville Orange Marmalade" in smaller italic on the second, and "340 g - small batch" in tiny capitals on the third. A small drawing of an orange sits above the text. A knife with marmalade on it and a slice of toast lie beside the jar.
11_hiking_selfie: A vertical front-camera phone selfie taken mid-hike on a mountain trail at noon. The subject is a woman of about twenty-eight, sweaty, with a sunburned nose, a smudge of dirt on her right cheek and wind-tangled hair, wearing a faded blue technical t-shirt with a backpack strap visible on one shoulder. She squints against the sun with a tired grin. Behind her a dirt trail winds through pine forest toward a rocky ridge under a clear sky. Hard overhead sun puts deep shadows under her brow and chin and the forehead is slightly overexposed.
12_anime_cafe: A 2D anime illustration of a small traditional Japanese cafe interior at golden hour. A high-school girl with shoulder-length auburn hair and amber eyes sits at a wooden counter, chin resting in her hand, smiling toward an off-screen barista. A hanging noren curtain above the counter is navy with white characters reading "珈琲屋 月舟". Sunlight slants through a paper screen on the right and casts soft striped shadows across the cedar floor. A porcelain dripper, a glass server and a small potted plant sit on the counter. Flat cel shading, warm peach and sand palette, clean line art, soft highlights in the hair.
13_movie_poster: A photograph of a vintage movie poster mounted on the textured plaster wall of an old cinema lobby, lit from above by a small brass wall sconce. The poster is a painted black-and-white illustration of a woman in a 1960s dress standing on a foggy train platform. Across the top the title "THE LAST TRAIN" is set in tall cream serif capitals. Below the illustration a cast line in small capitals reads "ELEANOR HAYES - DAVID OKADA - MARA VILLETTE". At the bottom an italic tagline reads "Some journeys end where they begin." The poster's lower corners curl slightly and the sconce gives the paper a warm tungsten glow.
14_paperback_bench: A paperback novel lies face-up on a weathered wooden park bench in low autumn sun. The cover is matte cream with a small painted illustration of a girl in a yellow raincoat in the centre. The title "THE LANTERN KEEPER" runs across the top in dark serif capitals, and the author name "Mara Villette" sits below the illustration in smaller italic. Along the bottom edge a short line of small grey text reads "A quiet novel about a town that forgot how to grieve." One corner of the book is slightly lifted. Fallen maple leaves surround the book and long shadows cross the slats.
15_newspaper_man: A candid photograph of an elderly man reading a broadsheet newspaper on an empty park bench in late autumn. He is about seventy-one, with thinning white hair, deep forehead lines, age spots on his hands and reading glasses sliding down his nose, wearing a brown corduroy jacket and a green wool scarf. The newspaper is held open and its headline, partly visible above the fold, reads "Local Vote Today" in black serif type. His hands are weathered with prominent knuckles. Behind him bare maple branches and a few yellow leaves on the ground. Soft diffused overcast light, slightly desaturated natural colour.
17_gym_mirror: A vertical phone mirror selfie in a small gym. A man of about thirty-six in a grey sweat-stained t-shirt holds the phone at chest height, his face partly cropped at the top of the frame, with visible pores on his cheeks and a small shaving nick on his jaw. In the mirror behind him an older woman in a purple tank top lifts a small dumbbell. The mirror has a few scuff marks and a smudge. Flat fluorescent ceiling light gives the skin a slightly yellow-green cast. On the far wall a motivational poster reads "EARN IT" in big white block capitals on black.
18_papercut_fu: A traditional Chinese paper-cut artwork in crimson red paper on a cream background, photographed flat. The composition is symmetrical: a central round medallion contains the character "福" in elaborate paper-cut strokes, surrounded by a ring of plum blossoms. Two koi fish curve around the medallion, their scales made of small punched semicircles. In the four corners, smaller characters sit inside small squares: "吉" top left, "春" top right, "安" bottom left, "祥" bottom right. The paper shows visible fibres and slight unevenness from hand cutting.
19_film_noir: A black-and-white photograph in the style of a 1947 film noir still. A man in a rumpled trench coat and fedora stands under a street lamp in a rain-soaked alley, seen from a low angle, a cigarette glowing between his fingers. Rain streaks diagonally across the frame, lit from behind by the single lamp. Behind him a wet brick wall reflects the light in long vertical streaks. Deep in the background a small neon sign reads "BAR". Deep shadows swallow the corners of the frame, with hard contrast and fine film grain.
20_tattoo_window: A street-level photograph of a small tattoo parlour window on a Brooklyn block in late afternoon. Dozens of small flash-tattoo prints are taped inside the glass. A printed white sign on the glass reads on four lines: "Walk-ins welcome", "Minimum $80", "Cash & Card", and "不议价 NO HAGGLING", the English in clean sans-serif and the Chinese in a brush font. The door beside the window is painted black with a brass handle, and a red neon "OPEN" sign glows inside. Low raking sunlight catches dust on the glass and a faint reflection of the street.
